summary.text: Colin Jack is a Republican state representative from Utah House District 73 who is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An electrical engineer, Jack was appointed to the House in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Colin Jack's career experience includes working as an electrical engineer and chief operating officer for Dixie Power in St. George, Utah.
Jack served as a delegate, precinct chair, district chair, party vice-chair, and on the state central committee for the Republican Party.
Jack was appointed to the Utah House of Representatives to replace Travis Seegmiller and represented District 62 from 2022 to 2023.
He has represented District 73 since 2023, succeeding Phil Lyman.
